# Graph routing regression corpus

This project freezes the fifteen source graphs that established routing score ceilings. Their original source and metadata preserve graph identities and complexity; simplifying the graphs would invalidate those ceilings. The remaining assets provide only call, event and typed spawn signatures. No playable scene, terrain or game composition is included.

`fixtures.json` records each source and reason for inclusion. Tests own this corpus independently of Voidweaver. Existing admission/quarantine policy still applies to the routing checks.
